# GAOMON Official Blog

> GAOMON's official blog covering digital drawing tablets, pen tablet guides, product reviews, and creative industry events.

GAOMON is a leading manufacturer of pen tablets and digital drawing devices. The blog serves as a resource hub for digital artists, providing product information, beginner guides, event coverage, and tech articles related to drawing tablets and creative tools.

## Key Topics

- Pen Tablet
- GAOMON Products
- Digital Drawing
- Beginner Guide
- Product Reviews
- Event Coverage
- Pen Tablet Parameters
- Drawing Contest
- GAOMON M106K PRO
- Wacom
- GAOMON S620
- GAOMON S630
- Tech Articles
- Product Showcase
- OtaZo

## Pen Tablet Guides & Tutorials

- [How to Choose a Pen Tablet for Beginners](https://blog.gaomon.net/how-to-choose-a-pen-tablet-for-beginners): Comprehensive guide for beginners selecting their first pen tablet
- [Beginner's Guide to Understand the Parameters of Pen Tablet](https://blog.gaomon.net/parameters-of-pen-tablet): Beginner tutorial explaining pen tablet specifications and parameters
- [Do Beginners Need to Buy a Pen Tablet?](https://blog.gaomon.net/why_buy_pen_tablet): Analysis of pen tablet importance for beginner digital painters

## Products & Events

- [GAOMON Pen Tablet M106K PRO in 2023 OtaZo](https://blog.gaomon.net/gaomon-in-2023-otazo): Event coverage of GAOMON M106K PRO sponsorship at OtaZo anime convention
